subject: Join us for the dartRverse Workshop – Harness the Force of R in 2026!

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Join us for the dartRverse Workshop – Harness the Force of R in 2026!
parts:
Dear Conservation Genomic Padawans and Masters alike,

We’re excited to announce our 2026 workshop “dartRverse: Harnessing the Force of R for Conservation Genomics”, running 8–14 March at the ANU Kioloa Coastal Campus (with online options).

Join us for a week-long journey across Episodes I–VI, from diversity to adaptation to leadership in science.

Flyer attached → all details, speakers, and registration link included.

We’d love to see you there. 

May the (R) Force be with you!

The dartRverse team
